items.item: Selection rule, smooth-curve rank, stable primary domain
items.check: Verified the root congruence, negativity in the operative nonnegative-primary domain, Riemann-Roch D=((r+2)(g-1)+n+|a|)/r, and r=2 specialization D=2g-2+n with descendant degree g-1.
items.dependency_limit: No new compactified spin-stack local-freeness or base-change proof; arbitrary negative primary labels not included.

items.item: Zero-primary deformation, nonseparating-node degree and modified unit
items.check: Checked rank D+m/r before forgetting and degree D-(r-1)m/r after; node child rank D+m/r-1+(b+c)/r; b+c=r survives while b=c=0 has insufficient rank. Child/parent normalization ratio r cancels inverse-pairing r when rewriting in normalized child classes. Appending r-1 changes normalization by -r and (2.19) contributes -psi/r, giving +psi.
items.rejected_extraction_error: Actual page 16 reads D+m/r, not the extracted D+m.
items.dependency_limit: Full separating-node and stack-theoretic derivations not reconstructed.

items.item: Unmarked top-degree exception and finite kappa coefficients
items.check: Homogeneity comparison gives [delta(g-1)-d](Omega_g,0^d-Omega_tilde_g,0^d)=0 for stable n=0; delta=3 exception d=3g-3 retained. Exact rational series gives s1=3,s2=-21/2,s3=69,s4=-2529/4,s5=36243/5 and agrees with displayed weighted-degree components 0 through 5.
items.dependency_limit: Finite algebra does not prove all-degree geometric relations, Teleman's theorem, Chow/Pixton claims, or the unmarked Euler-characteristic integral.

items.item: Proposition 5.6 at r=2, proof commutator and downstream use
items.check: Analytically checked every formal-series hypothesis, shift, normal ordering and exact nonzero H_1^2 coefficient for Z0=(1-t1)^(-1/8). Checked the missing weight-two premise in (5.19) and explicit use through Proposition 5.18 to Theorem 5.20.
items.dependency_limit: Does not refute the particular BGW equality, certify the r>=3 proof, or verify the cited external replacement constraints.
